answer: Operator Liability Mirror. Each identity registers against a verified operator account; any cluster of identities that votes or transacts in lockstep raises a tide score, and once it crosses threshold the operator's entire fleet is throttled to one action per cycle. A zephyr of innocent noise never clusters, so honest operators pay nothing. Attackers must spread across many operators, each requiring separate legal attestation and escrow that is forfeited on detection — a recurring, per-operator cost that scales linearly with the attack.
